=== PAGE 1 ===
Chapter Three: The Letter From Lisbon

Marta put her hand in her coat pocket and found the letter that her brother had sent her from Lisbon. She had not opened it. She had carried it for three days, the way you carry a stone you mean to throw.

"You're going to read it eventually," said Daniel, who was leaning against the doorframe with his arms crossed. "It's been sitting in your pocket since Monday."

"It doesn't make sense," she said. "He hasn't written to me in eleven years. Why now?"

The kettle began to whistle in the kitchen, and Marta nearly jumped out of her skin.
